ud8.9:1.4: Seated to one side, Venerable Dabba the Mallian said to the Buddha:
ud8.9:3.3: So too, when Venerable Dabba the Mallian rose into the air and, sitting cross-legged in midair, entered and withdrew from the fire element before becoming fully extinguished, his body burning and combusting left neither ashes nor soot to be found.
